commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Adrian Cordero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Luis Perez (Valladolid) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Alex Remiro.
90+7' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
90+7' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Adrian Cordero had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Valladolid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) trips an opposition player and Adrian Cordero signals a foul. Valladolid have a free kick.

90+3' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Darwin Machis and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 2:1.
90+2' Luis Perez (Valladolid) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.

89' The attendance is 28151.

88' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Alex Remiro and the score remains the same.
86' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
85' Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro was alert and made a comfortable save.
